title: A Teaspoon of This Weighs 4 Billion Tons

scenes.voiceover: A single teaspoon of this star weighs four billion tons.
scenes.visualConcept: host cold open, shocking number slam

scenes.voiceover: It's called a neutron star. The crushed core of a dead sun.
scenes.mainText: it's the core of a DEAD STAR

scenes.voiceover: Gravity crushed an entire star's mass into a ball the size of a city.
scenes.mainText: a whole star, squeezed into a CITY

scenes.voiceover: It's so dense that one sugar cube of it would outweigh Mount Everest.
And some of them spin seven hundred times every single second.
The strongest ones could wipe every hard drive on Earth from the distance of the Moon.
scenes.mainText: it could erase Earth from the MOON

scenes.voiceover: The universe is stranger than fiction. Follow mindwired for more.
